description_en: Determines whether an image is AI-generated and returns the detection label and confidence score
description_zh: 判断图片是否由AI生成，并返回检测标签及置信度
name: DetectAigcImage

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image to be detected. Only the HTTP and HTTPS protocols are supported. Specify at least one of ImageUrl and ObjectKey
parameters.help_zh: 待检测图片的 URL 地址，仅支持 HTTP/HTTPS 协议。`ImageUrl` 与 `ObjectKey` 二选一，至少提供一个
parameters.name: image_url

Body.description_en: The list of AIGC detection result labels
Body.description_zh: AIGC 检测结果标签列表

Confidence.description_en: Confidence score. Valid values: 0 to 1. A larger value indicates a higher probability
Confidence.description_zh: 置信度，取值范围 0~1，值越大表示可能性越高

Label.description_en:
Detection label. Valid values:
ai_generated: AI-generated.
non_ai_generated: Non-AI-generated
Label.description_zh:
检测标签。取值：
`ai_generated`（AI 生成）
`non_ai_generated`（非 AI 生成）

Code.description_en: The business error code. If the request is successful, OK is returned
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码。请求成功时返回 `OK`

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. If the request is successful, 200 is returned
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP 状态码。请求成功时返回 `200`

Message.description_en: The additional information. If the request is successful, success is returned
Message.description_zh: 附加信息。请求成功时返回 `success`

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true：调用成功。                                 false：调用失败
